title: Medevac
description: SAVANNAH, Ga. - The Coast Guard medically evacuates a 50-year-old-man 25-miles east of Tybee Island, Ga., Wednesday July 28, 2010. The Coast Guard received a distress call at approximately 11 a.m. for a diver in distress.   U.S. Coast Guard video
